issue.title: Warn before a hijacked agent's held workspace claim expires
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #4) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md), which deferred an expiry-warning notification.

A hijack hold expires `workspace.held_claim_ttl_days` (default 14) after `hijacked_at`. The stale-running cleanup sweep (src/sase/ace/scheduler/stale_running_sweep.py with src/sase/agent/hijack/custody.py) then snapshots, releases the claim, moves the ledger record to `expired`, and sets done.json `recovery.state: expired`. Keep-work recovery (Escalate/Continue/Instruct) is no longer offered after that. Nothing warns the user beforehand.

Shape: when an active `held` record is within a configurable window of expiry (for example 2 days), upsert one deduplicated notification naming the agent, workspace, and `sase agent recover NAME`. Retire it when the hijack resolves or expires.

task_type_fields.proposal: Upsert one deduplicated notification when an active held hijack is within a configurable window of held_claim_ttl_days measured from hijacked_at, naming the agent, workspace, and sase agent recover NAME, retired on resolution or expiry.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The hijack epic implemented TTL expiry with a snapshot gate but explicitly deferred any pre-expiry notification.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1qz's land phase (sase-1qz.11) deferred an expiry warning; keep-work recovery silently stops being offered once the 14-day hold expires.
